title: Past Simple - positive
explanationEn: Use Past Simple for finished actions in the past.

ru.explanation: Past Simple используется для завершённых действий в прошлом.

title: Past Simple - questions
formula: Did you work? / Did she go?
explanationEn: Use did + base verb to ask about the past.

ru.explanation: Используйте did + начальная форма глагола, чтобы задать вопрос о прошлом.

title: Past Simple - negative
formula: I didn't work. / She didn't go.
explanationEn: Use didn't + base verb to make the Past Simple negative.

ru.explanation: Используйте didn't + начальная форма глагола для отрицания в Past Simple.

title: Comparative adjectives
explanationEn: Use comparatives to compare two things.

ru.explanation: Сравнительная степень используется, чтобы сравнить два предмета.

title: Future with 'going to'
explanationEn: Use be + going to for plans and intentions.

ru.explanation: Используйте be + going to для планов и намерений.

title: Should - advice
formula: You should rest. / You shouldn't worry.

title: Must / have to - obligation
formula: I have to work. / You must stop.
explanationEn: Use must or have to for obligation or rules.

ru.explanation: Используйте must или have to для обязанности или правил.

title: Present Perfect - introduction
explanationEn: Use the Present Perfect for life experiences, without saying exactly when.

ru.explanation: Present Perfect используется для жизненного опыта, без указания точного времени.
